# Image Prompting Studio

A Muse agent skill that turns a brief into copyable, faithful image-generation prompts — create, edit, camera studies, storyboards, typography, infographics, series, grids, brand interpretation, and Midjourney prompt syntax — with per-model profiles and validators. It prepares prompts only: the user runs them in their own tool (Midjourney, ChatGPT Images, Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, Ideogram, Luma). Ported from a community plugin.
